src='''def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rmax=max(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(row))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        s=rmax-r
        for c,x in enumerate(row):
            if x and 0<=c-s<W: out[r][c-s]=x
    return out
'''
